UPDATE calendar_backfill_jobs
        SET status = 'pending',
            cursor = '{}',
            scanned_count = 0,
            extracted_count = 0,
            last_error = NULL,
            started_at = NULL,
            completed_at = NULL,
            lease_expires_at = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE email_link_id = $1
          AND grant_version = $2
          AND status = 'failed'
          AND kind = 'google_calendar'
        RETURNING id, account_id, kind
